mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of simple proteins united with a coloured prosthetic group."
The chromoproteins are composed of simple proteins united with a coloured prosthetic group.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the smallest units obtained when complex proteins are broken down in the process of digestion."
Amino acids are the smallest units obtained when complex proteins are broken down in the process of digestion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the continuous assessment component of your course."
The TMA is the continuous assessment component of your course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of a combination of one molecule of d -glucose and one molecule of d -fructose."
Sucrose is made up of a combination of one molecule of d -glucose and one molecule of d -fructose.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for controlling the basal metabolic rate and is therefore important in growth regulation."
Thyroxine is responsible for controlling the basal metabolic rate and is therefore important in growth regulation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are defined as those proteins, which on hydrolysis yield only amino acids or their derivatives."
Simple proteins are defined as those proteins, which on hydrolysis yield only amino acids or their derivatives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the least soluble of all the proteins."
The albuminoids are the least soluble of all the proteins.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a diverse group of naturally occurring organic compounds that are related by their solubility in non polar organic solvents (chloroform, acetone & benzene) and general insolubility in water."

Lipids are a diverse group of naturally occurring organic compounds that are related by their solubility in non polar organic solvents (chloroform, acetone & benzene) and general insolubility in water.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most important of the simple sugars."
The hexoses and pentoses are the most important of the simple sugars.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the simplest forms of sugars and make up oligosaccharides and the polysaccharides."
The monosaccharides are the simplest forms of sugars and make up oligosaccharides and the polysaccharides.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tertiary amine which is formed by the oxidation of choline."
Betaine is a tertiary amine which is formed by the oxidation of choline.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a naturally occurring antioxidant which functions as the first line of defense against peroxidation of polyunsaturated fatty acids contained in cellular and sub-cellular membrane phospholipids."

Vitamin E is a naturally occurring antioxidant which functions as the first line of defense against peroxidation of polyunsaturated fatty acids contained in cellular and sub-cellular membrane phospholipids.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a nucleoside to which phosphoric acid or PO4 group has been attached."
A nucleotide is a nucleoside to which phosphoric acid or PO4 group has been attached.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called glucans, while those consisting of fructose, mannose and xylose alone are referred to as fructans, mannans and xylans, respectively."
Polysaccharides consisting mainly of glucose are called glucans, while those consisting of fructose, mannose and xylose alone are referred to as fructans, mannans and xylans, respectively.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fundamental unit from which all carbohydrates are formed."
The monosaccharide is the fundamental unit from which all carbohydrates are formed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of simple proteins combined with mucopolysaccharides such as hyaluronic acid and the chondrotin sulphates."
The mucoproteins are composed of simple proteins combined with mucopolysaccharides such as hyaluronic acid and the chondrotin sulphates.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an amide which is the main end-product of nitrogen metabolism in mammals, although it also occurs in many plants and has been detected in wheat; soya bean, potato and cabbage."
Urea is an amide which is the main end-product of nitrogen metabolism in mammals, although it also occurs in many plants and has been detected in wheat; soya bean, potato and cabbage.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a coenzyme of carboxylase enzymes which catalyze the transfer of carbon dioxide from one substrate to another."
Biotin is a coenzyme of carboxylase enzymes which catalyze the transfer of carbon dioxide from one substrate to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the simplest of the proteins and may be regarded as large polypeptides."
The protamins are the simplest of the proteins and may be regarded as large polypeptides.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as the prosthetic (addition) group."
The non-protein group is referred to as the prosthetic (addition) group.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most abundant mineral in the body of the animals with over 99% of it present in the bones and teeth."
Calcium is the most abundant mineral in the body of the animals with over 99% of it present in the bones and teeth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are concerned with reactions of hydrogen transport and are important in carbohydrate and amino acid metabolism."
Flavoproteins are concerned with reactions of hydrogen transport and are important in carbohydrate and amino acid metabolism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a substance that is synthesised in one tissue and transported by the circulatory system to act on another organ."
A hormone is a substance that is synthesised in one tissue and transported by the circulatory system to act on another organ.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called α - 1, 4 glycosidic link."
The bond is called α - 1, 4 glycosidic link.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of simple proteins combined with some non-protein substance."
Conjugated or complex proteins are composed of simple proteins combined with some non-protein substance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an atrophy of the myocardium with replacement fibrosis."
Falling disease in grazing cattle is an atrophy of the myocardium with replacement fibrosis.
fib: ______ is an intermediate resulting from the hydrolysis and digestion of starch as well as the action of heat on starch.
Dextrin
Dextrin is an intermediate resulting from the hydrolysis and digestion of starch as well as the action of heat on starch.
______ is the prosthetic group of the posphoproteins. (phosphoserine has been isolated from casein and vitellin) Casein of milk and vitellin of egg yolk are the best known phosphoproteins.
Phosphoric acid
Phosphoric acid is the prosthetic group of the posphoproteins. (phosphoserine has been isolated from casein and vitellin) Casein of milk and vitellin of egg yolk are the best known phosphoproteins.
______ is a complex nitrogenous base containing a pyrimidine ring joined to a thiazole ring.
Thiamin
Thiamin is a complex nitrogenous base containing a pyrimidine ring joined to a thiazole ring.
______ is an amide of pantoic acid and β-alanine.
Pantothenic acid
Pantothenic acid is an amide of pantoic acid and β-alanine.
______ is one of the four bases, cytosine, thymine, adenine or guanine.
Attached to each sugar group
Attached to each sugar group is one of the four bases, cytosine, thymine, adenine or guanine.
______ is termed ribonucleic acid (RNA) while one containing deoxyribose is referred to as deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA).
nucleotide containing ribose
A nucleotide containing ribose is termed ribonucleic acid (RNA) while one containing deoxyribose is referred to as deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA).
______ is a sweet-tasting protein found in some fruits.
Monellin
Monellin is a sweet-tasting protein found in some fruits.
______ is a tube into which other molecules or atoms can fit.
helix
The helix is a tube into which other molecules or atoms can fit.
______ is made up of polymerized glucose molecules ranging from 900 - 2, 000 molecules.
Cellulose
Cellulose is made up of polymerized glucose molecules ranging from 900 - 2, 000 molecules.
______ is used to synthesize UDP-glucose, UDP- galactose, UDP-glucuronic acid and other UDP-sugars.
Uridine trinucleotide
Uridine trinucleotide is used to synthesize UDP-glucose, UDP- galactose, UDP-glucuronic acid and other UDP-sugars.
______ is a significant coenzyme in the process of gluconeogenesis.
Cobalamin
Cobalamin is a significant coenzyme in the process of gluconeogenesis.
______ is the most actively functioning form of Vitamin B6 in the form of its phosphate.
Pyridoxal
Pyridoxal is the most actively functioning form of Vitamin B6 in the form of its phosphate.
______ are composed of two parts which can be separated by varying concentrations of divalent cations (mgH is often used).
ribosomes
The ribosomes are composed of two parts which can be separated by varying concentrations of divalent cations (mgH is often used).
______ are used as carriers and activators of a variety of groups in biosynthesis reactions. (NTP is nucleoside trinucleotides).
Different parts of NTP molecules
Different parts of NTP molecules are used as carriers and activators of a variety of groups in biosynthesis reactions. (NTP is nucleoside trinucleotides).
______ is a component of lecithins which play a vital role in cellular structure and activity.
Choline
Choline is a component of lecithins which play a vital role in cellular structure and activity.
______ are those minerals recognised to carry out vital roles and which must be present in the feed.
Essential minerals
Essential minerals are those minerals recognised to carry out vital roles and which must be present in the feed.
______ is a polysaccharide found in animal and fungal cells.
Glycogen
Glycogen is a polysaccharide found in animal and fungal cells.
______ is a specialized ganglion without axonal extensions.
adrenal medulla
The adrenal medulla is a specialized ganglion without axonal extensions.
______ is a storage carbohydrate found in plants.
Starch
Starch is a storage carbohydrate found in plants.
______ are the two major protein elements of the contractile system of skeletal muscle.
Actin and myosin
Actin and myosin are the two major protein elements of the contractile system of skeletal muscle.
______ are a group of compounds containing carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen (about 16%) and sulphur.
Proteins
Proteins are a group of compounds containing carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen (about 16%) and sulphur.
______ is the generic name of nicotinic acid and nicotinamide, of which may act as a source of the vitamin in the diet.
Niacin
Niacin is the generic name of nicotinic acid and nicotinamide, of which may act as a source of the vitamin in the diet.
______ are composed of simple basic proteins (protamins or histones) in salt combinations with nucleic acids as the prosthetic groups.
nucleoproteins
The nucleoproteins are composed of simple basic proteins (protamins or histones) in salt combinations with nucleic acids as the prosthetic groups.
______ is one of the purest forms of cellulose.
Natural cotton
Natural cotton is one of the purest forms of cellulose.
______ is the generic name covering folic acid and related substances having the biochemical activity of folic acid.
Folacin
Folacin is the generic name covering folic acid and related substances having the biochemical activity of folic acid.
______ are a group of aliphatic carboxylic (-COOH) acids, which contain from 2 to 24 or more carbon atoms.
Fatty acids
Fatty acids are a group of aliphatic carboxylic (-COOH) acids, which contain from 2 to 24 or more carbon atoms.
